description.value: The Blue Nile is a sit-down East African restaurant in the heart of Victoria specializing in authentic Ethiopian and Eritrean cuisine, where dishes of richly spiced stews, lentils, and vegetables are served communally atop injera flatbread. The menu is extensive, covering poultry, beef, and a full range of vegan and vegetarian dishes, with gluten-free substitutions available. Ethiopian coffee (Bunna) is prepared tableside in the traditional roast-and-brew ceremony, making this a distinctive cultural dining stop for touring cyclists passing through downtown Victoria.

bike_parking_detail: 3 racks within 100m: rack (2 spaces) at 49m; rack at 69m; rack (3 spaces) at 80m. Total: 5 spaces.
